sentences.japanese: 近ごろの親は概して子供に甘いので、マナーの知らない子供が多い。
sentences.english: As these days most parents indulge their children, many children don't know what good manners are.

sentences.japanese: 学生は、概して自分たちの抱えている問題を理解してくれる教師が好きだ。
sentences.english: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.

sentences.japanese: 概して彼女は早起きだ。
sentences.english: As a rule, she is an early riser.

sentences.japanese: 概して日本人は働き者だ。
sentences.english: Generally speaking, Japanese are hard workers.

sentences.japanese: 概して日本の気候は温和であると言える。
sentences.english: It may be said, as a rule, that the climate of Japan is mild.
